methods.rationale: Route d2: total China-to-US vinegar volume (p3, annualized) × growth to 2024 (a4) × Hengshun share (a1) × bottled share (a3) × 1000 ml/L / bottle size (a2). Main failure modes: Hengshun share is the dominant uncertainty; p3 is a 2020-2022 cumulative that must be annualized; a4 bridges a period gap. p17 is a cross-check anchor but not used here to avoid double-counting the same source family.

Route d7: annual shipment count × bottles per shipment. Anchored on the observed bill of lading (p57: 700 cases × 24 = 16,800 bottles) and ImportGenius shipment history (p54). Very wide uncertainty because shipment frequency and size are poorly observed; serves as an independent order-of-magnitude check on m1.

assumptions.name: Hengshun share of China HS2209 vinegar exports to the US
assumptions.rationale: Hengshun is the largest branded Chinese vinegar exporter, but the US-bound HS2209 flow includes many small producers and bulk/industrial vinegar. A 5-40% share is a wide, honest prior; no kept point supplies it.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to convert total China-to-US HS2209 volume into Hengshun-attributable volume; assumes Hengshun's share of US-bound volume is similar to its share of total Chinese vinegar exports.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's export share is far outside 5-40%, or that most US-bound HS2209 is bulk/non-Hengshun industrial vinegar.

assumptions.name: Average Hengshun export bottle size
assumptions.rationale: Kept product listings (p37-p48) cluster at 500 ml with some 535/550/580 ml; a volume-weighted mean near 520 ml is reasonable.
assumptions.applies_when: Converts liters of Hengshun US-bound vinegar into bottle counts.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that US-bound Hengshun is dominated by a single size far from 520 ml (e.g., mostly 300 ml or bulk).

assumptions.name: Bottled share of Hengshun US-bound vinegar volume
assumptions.rationale: Most Hengshun export product is retail bottled, but some bulk/industrial drums likely ship; a high bottled share with wide uncertainty.
assumptions.applies_when: Applied to total Hengshun US-bound volume to isolate bottled vinegar before dividing by bottle size.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence of substantial bulk/drum exports to the US or of food-service packaging dominating.

assumptions.name: Annual US-bound China HS2209 volume growth 2020-2022 average to 2024
assumptions.rationale: p3 covers 2020-2022 (avg ~2.2M L/yr); p17 covers 2019-07 to 2020-06 (~4.4M L). The two anchors disagree by ~2x, so a growth/level factor with wide range is needed to bring the older anchor to 2024.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to project the 2020-2022 average US-bound volume to 2024.
assumptions.falsified_by: Customs data showing 2024 US-bound HS2209 volume far outside the implied range.

assumptions.name: Bottles per Hengshun US shipment (annualized shipment count)
assumptions.rationale: p57 shows 700 pieces (cases) × 24 bottles = 16,800 bottles on one bill of lading; a full container load could be several times that. Used with an assumed shipments-per-year to build a flow.
assumptions.applies_when: Used in the shipment-based route; assumes typical Hengshun US shipments resemble the observed bill of lading in scale.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that typical shipments are much smaller (LCL) or much larger (multiple containers).

assumptions.name: Hengshun US-bound shipments per year
assumptions.rationale: p54 records 44 shipments over ~16 years (~3/yr) but that is stale and all-products; recent growth and multiple distributors suggest a higher current rate. Wide range.
assumptions.applies_when: Multiplied by bottles per shipment to give annual US bottle flow.
assumptions.falsified_by: Import records showing far fewer or far more annual Hengshun US shipments.

assessment.note: Same source (m.x315.cn customs summary) for China HS22090000 vinegar exports 2020-2022; p5 is the US share implied by p3/p6. All share one underlying customs measurement, so they are not independent of each other.

Same customs snapshot for 2019-07 to 2020-06; p19 is p18/p17. Consistent with p3/p4 order of magnitude (US ~2.2M L/yr vs ~4.4M L/yr in the earlier window), suggesting a decline or definitional shift, not a contradiction.

p54 and p69 are duplicate copies of the same ImportGenius total (44 shipments, 2006-2022). p55/p56 are facets of the same record set. All are stale (ends 2022-08) and cover all products, not just vinegar.
Duplicate copies of one bill of lading: 550ml@24, 700 pieces. Gives a bottle-size and case-pack anchor but a single shipment, not an annual flow.
Duplicate container dimensions from the same bill of lading; usable only as a container-volume sanity check, not a flow.
Distributor catalog bottle sizes for Hengshun export SKUs: mostly 500ml, some 535/550/580/300ml. Supports an average bottle size near 500-550ml for the volume-to-bottle conversion.
Weee/Amazon retail listings for Hengshun 18.6 fl oz (~550ml) SKU; p81 (2015 weekly 600+) and p96 (600+ sold) are lower bounds on one SKU in one channel, not US totals.

Declared as a part (retail sell-through) rather than full coverage because it measures sell-through, not Hengshun's export shipments, and inventory changes are unmodeled; code will keep it out of the full-estimate combination.

kept.name: Hengshun share of China HS2209 vinegar export volume to the US
kept.rationale: Hengshun is the leading branded Zhenjiang vinegar exporter, but HS2209 US-bound volume includes many producers and bulk/industrial vinegar; a mid-teens volume share is plausible. No kept point gives this share.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun competes in the same US-bound HS2209 flow and its brand share is in the stated range.
kept.falsified_by: Customs or company disclosure showing Hengshun's US export volume below 5% or above 35% of China's HS2209 US volume.

kept.name: Annual US-bound China HS2209 vinegar volume, 2024 (liters/year)
kept.rationale: p3 gives 6.60M L over 2020-2022 (~2.2M L/yr); p17 gives 4.38M L for 2019-07..2020-06. The two windows bracket a plausible 2024 level near 2.2M L/yr with wide uncertainty from trend and definitional drift.
kept.applies_when: 2024 China-to-US HS2209 volume is near the 2020-2022 average rather than the earlier 2019-20 peak.
kept.falsified_by: 2024 customs data showing US-bound HS2209 volume outside 1.2-4.0M L.

kept.name: Average Hengshun export bottle size (liters per bottle)
kept.rationale: Catalog SKUs (p37-p48) cluster at 500ml with some 535/550/580ml and a 300ml premium SKU; bill of lading p71 shows 550ml. A volume-weighted average near 0.52L is consistent.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's US-bound bottled mix resembles the export catalog SKU mix.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that most US-bound Hengshun volume is bulk/drum or in much smaller/larger bottles.

kept.name: Bottled (vs bulk) share of Hengshun US-bound vinegar volume
kept.rationale: Retail listings (p81, p96, p98, p100) show Hengshun sold in consumer bottles in the US; some HS2209 flow is bulk/industrial, so a high but not complete bottled share is assumed.
kept.applies_when: Most Hengshun US shipments are consumer bottles rather than food-service bulk.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of large bulk/drum Hengshun shipments to US food manufacturers.

kept.name: Hengshun share of China HS2209 export value to the US
kept.rationale: Hengshun's branded premium positioning implies a higher value share than volume share; used in the value-based route as an alternative to the volume-share route.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's US export price per liter is above the HS2209 average, so value share exceeds volume share.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's US export prices are at or below the HS2209 average.

kept.name: Annual US-bound China HS2209 vinegar value, 2024 (USD/year)
kept.rationale: p4 gives $8.46M over 2020-2022 (~$2.8M/yr); p18 gives $5.16M for 2019-07..2020-06. A 2024 level near $2.8M/yr with wide uncertainty is consistent with the volume trend.
kept.applies_when: 2024 US-bound HS2209 value is near the 2020-2022 average.

kept.name: Average Hengshun US export price per liter (USD/liter)
kept.rationale: p19 gives $1.18/L for all HS2209 to the US in 2019-20; Hengshun branded retail prices (p98, p101, p104) imply higher FOB prices for branded Zhenjiang vinegar, so a premium over the HS2209 average is assumed.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's US FOB price per liter is above the HS2209 average, consistent with branded retail pricing.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun US FOB prices are near or below $1.18/L.

kept.name: Hengshun US retail unit sales coverage multiplier (one observed SKU/platform to national sell-through)
kept.rationale: p81/p96 give 600+ weekly units for one SKU on one platform; scaling to all US channels (Asian grocers, mainstream retail, food service) requires a large multiplier with wide uncertainty.
kept.applies_when: The observed 600+/week SKU is representative of Hengshun's US retail velocity and channel coverage is in the stated range.
kept.falsified_by: Scanner data showing Hengshun US retail sales far outside the implied range.

residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
